opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 individuals with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Funding to bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis, fostering collaboration and mentoring.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: Up to £500 per year for a decade of data collection; £3,500 claimable in year 1 (first five years' funding) and an additional £3,500 in year 6.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies (e.g. ecological restoration, habitat creation, control of alien species, climate change) anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research informing teaching and learning practices in ecology, improving learners' experience and promoting excellence in teaching.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed from the applicant.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for interdisciplinary placements (secondments) of up to 12 months, immersing an ecologist in another discipline, NGO/charity, public sector organisation or business.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Funding provided for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: Funding for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; no restrictions on where applicants come from.
opportunities.summary: Funding for individuals, teams and organisations to deliver independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities engaging public audiences with ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 for in-person events.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher; work/study at a university or research institution; work in scientific areas within the BES remit.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and to present their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 in the UK, covering travel and related costs.
